context_requirements: Basal or induced ICAM1 expression; without ICAM1 transcription, no transcriptional effect is expected.
An inflammatory or adhesion stimulus may be required to see ICAM1-dependent changes.
The drug must engage its target in the cell line; no target engagement data are available.
falsifiers: A reproducible decrease in ICAM1 mRNA at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines would contradict the prediction of no transcriptional response.
Consistent changes in inflammatory, interferon, or adhesion-related landmark genes across multiple cell lines would contradict the no-response hypothesis.
A dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 10 micromolar in responsive lines would indicate an off-target or unanticipated mechanism.
